project_type: Full-stack monorepo: Node.js Express backend + Expo React Native mobile + Vite React admin
build_system: npm workspaces, no package manager available in sandbox
build_command: N/A - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, cannot install dependencies
verification_instructions: AST-level validation only; verify files parse correctly with node --check for backend JS files
setup_instructions: N/A - code-only changes, cannot run npm install
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot npm install, pull images, or access external registries. Only modify files and commit.
contribution_requirements: Commit message format: fix: description. Push to fix/final-stabilization branch.
key_patterns: Backend uses ES modules with named exports. Mobile uses React Native StyleSheet, Redux Toolkit, expo-vector-icons Feather/Ionicons. Zod validation with .strict() for user updates. Dark theme on feed/detail screens, light theme on create/profile screens.
directory_structure: backend/src/modules/ - feature-based backend modules. mobile/src/screens/ - screen components. mobile/src/components/ - shared components. mobile/src/services/ - API layer.
